name: Narrative Production Skills Capability Benchmark
principles: measure capability profiles, not one story-quality score
separate deterministic contract checks from semantic judgement
score detection separately from root-cause routing and revision scope
treat approved decisions, pack constraints, and medium boundaries as hard ground truth
retain semantic evidence and refuse stale comparisons

suites.description: Seeded narrative defects and clean controls.
Five progressive end-to-end examples exercising complete production behaviour.
Every extension-pack showcase prompt, measuring medium/genre/style/audience/voice adherence.

releasePolicy.strictReadiness: all hard gates pass and every required scored dimension has median >= 2 on a 0-3 scale
releasePolicy.regression: previously passing strict case fails every repeat, or a previously acceptable required dimension has median <= 1 on an unchanged benchmark case
